Get the record ID prefix for a document in the database (internal)

Source: R/extraction.R
get_record_id_prefix.Rd

Looks up the document's values for the fields named in the metadata schema's x-record-id-fields. file_name is used without its extension.

Usage

get_record_id_prefix(con, document_id, metadata_schema_file = NULL)

Arguments

con

Database connection

document_id

Document ID

metadata_schema_file

Path to custom metadata schema JSON file (optional)

Value

Character record ID prefix
